corrected_fixture.reason: The extra combined-score boundary scenario used the Config default translation gate (5 m), while replay uses 2 m; the ungated association therefore passed this part. The original position-only regression did fail as expected.
corrected_fixture.action: After the raw six-route batch, set loop_max_icp_translation=2.0 explicitly in AssociatesPositionAndHeadingBeforeCheckingConsistency; rebuild the test, require ungated core failure and gated core success; freeze test-qualified source with identical runtime binaries and rerun CTest.
corrected_fixture.resolution: Set the test translation gate explicitly to the 2 m replay setting. The ungated association core fails and the current trace core passes the same corrected three-part behavior test.

query_inflation.reason: Full same-query sharing of the neighbor scatter reduces HelmDyn01 peak error but increases online RMSE by 0.344 mm and saved holdout RMSE by 0.175 mm in fixed-input trials. A query-count multiplier is not calibrated shared covariance. Preserve baseline weights pending stronger evidence.

uncertainty_ablation.coefficient_units_note: The old exploratory coefficients_m field is a vector, not a claim of uniform units: isotropic/geometry entries are m, angular-rate entry m*s/rad, speed entry s. The residual coefficient multiplies the square root of a fitness proxy, not certified sensor variance.

m2_reference_contract.scope: Read-only original ROS1 bag connection inventory and primary publication metadata; no estimator or scorer modification.
findings: Original bags contain no native Xsens output/lever-arm configuration or Leica clock stream from which the missing truth contract can be recovered.
The published calibration separates the Xsens IMU and GNSS antenna; geometric extrinsics alone do not identify which reference point the released position represents.
UBLOX native UTC is a separate receiver and is not a substitute for the Xsens truth clock.
The prior +54 ms effective angular lag and hall planar-course delay remain diagnostics; neither is used to retime position truth or alter the official comparison.
unresolved: Native Xsens and Leica timestamps and export/filter latency

findings: Section III-C uses a common system timestamp; its less-than-10 ms measured synchronization claim is specifically between cameras, not a verified LiDAR-to-GT clock bound.

Section III-D identifies the Leica prism target. The separate published calibration supplies Leica-to-LiDAR and Handsfree-to-LiDAR translations; their composition exactly matches the existing scorer. The hall reference geometry is documented, while its physical time contract remains unresolved.
The original bag topic inventory remains insufficient to recover native Leica time or Xsens position-output reference configuration.
additional_primary_audit.action: No score retiming or guessed reference correction; all original comparisons retained.

current_stage_audit.finding: Fixed sample support across every lag retains a roughly -1.9 to -2.1 s course/gyro discrepancy; held-out windows improve under prefix lag. Course smoothing and motion-model dependence still prevent calling this a physical clock calibration.

m2_fixed_support_timing_proxy.scope: Raw gyro vs released Leica course only, no LIO. Fixed common support for all lags and GT gaps <=0.3 s; no lag-dependent moving-sample selection. Prefix fit frozen for holdout, three predeclared smoothings. A planar forward-motion proxy cannot prove physical clock offset or turn-in-place attitude. No estimator, truth timestamp, position reference or official score changed.
